description: Only everyday tools are listed; the rest (automation rules, journeys, load tests, maintenance, notifications, reports, secrets, keywords, SLA, settings, admin …) are found here. No arguments: every tool you can run, by area. query: matching tools with a summary, effect and parameters. tools: their full input schemas. Run one with call_read_tool (reads) or call_tool (changes), or by its own name.

query.description: What you want to do, e.g. "maintenance window" or "mute alerts"

tools.description: Tool names whose full input schema to return

name: discover_tools
title: Discover Tools
